findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "numerology" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_numerology_life_path, post_numerology_karmic_debt, post_numerology_chart, post_numerology_daily, post_numerology_chaldean, post_numerology_business_name · Public sink: post_numerology_life_path, post_numerology_expression, post_numerology_bridge, post_numerology_soul_urge, post_numerology_personality, post_numerology_birth_day, post_numerology_maturity, post_numerology_karmic_lessons, post_numerology_karmic_debt, post_numerology_personal_day, post_numerology_personal_month, post_numerology_personal_year, post_numerology_compatibility, post_numerology_chart, post_numerology_daily, post_numerology_chaldean, post_numerology_dual, post_numerology_business_name.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_numerology_life_path, post_numerology_karmic_debt, post_numerology_chart, post_numerology_daily, post_numerology_chaldean, post_numerology_business_name · Public sink: post_numerology_life_path, post_numerology_expression, post_numerology_bridge, post_numerology_soul_urge, post_numerology_personality, post_numerology_birth_day, post_numerology_maturity, post_numerology_karmic_lessons, post_numerology_karmic_debt, post_numerology_personal_day, post_numerology_personal_month, post_numerology_personal_year, post_numerology_compatibility, post_numerology_chart, post_numerology_daily, post_numerology_chaldean, post_numerology_dual, post_numerology_business_name
